env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A main module's root external test is first party, like its internal test.
cd app
logos test -short -count=1 .
stdout 'ok\s+example\.com/app\s'
! stderr 'capabilities::'
! stdout 'capabilities::'

# A nested dependency's root external test remains third party.
! logos test -short -count=1 example.com/app/nested
stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/app/nested_test'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''

# A real dependency named with _test is not a synthetic external test.
! logos test -short -count=1 ./usesmirror
stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/app_test'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/app/usesmirror_test'''

# Plain go retains its semantics and does not register a capability-origin flag.
go test -short -count=1 . example.com/app/nested ./usesmirror
! stderr 'capabilities::'
! stdout 'capabilities::'

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/app/nested v0.0.0
	example.com/app_test v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/app/nested => ../nested
replace example.com/app_test => ../mirror

-- app/app.go --
package app

const Value = 3

-- app/app_test.go --
package app_test

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

func TestExternal(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		return
	}
	if err := exec.Command("true").Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

-- app/internal_test.go --
package app

import "testing"

func TestInternal(t *testing.T) {
	if Value != 3 {
		t.Fatal(Value)
	}
}

-- nested/go.mod --
module example.com/app/nested

go 1.27

-- nested/nested.go --
package nested

-- nested/nested_test.go --
package nested_test

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

func TestExternal(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		return
	}
	if err := exec.Command("true").Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

-- mirror/go.mod --
module example.com/app_test

go 1.27

-- mirror/mirror.go --
package mirror

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Run() error { return exec.Command("true").Run() }

-- app/usesmirror/usesmirror.go --
package usesmirror

-- app/usesmirror/usesmirror_test.go --
package usesmirror_test

import (
	"example.com/app_test"
	"testing"
)

func TestMirror(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		return
	}
	if err := mirror.Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
